name: vitalsync
description: VitalSync — sistema de monitoramento domiciliar pós-operatório

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @vitalsync/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @vitalsync/backend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @vitalsync/backend && npm run build --workspace @vitalsync/frontend
